clauses.title: Condition of Material on
clauses.text: 3. Condition of Material on Delivery - The hot-rolled wire rod shall be supplied in the form of coils or straigtened and cut lengths.The size and weight of coils shall be as agreed.

clauses.title: Freedom from Defects
clauses.text: 4. Freedom from Defects  -  The finished material shall be free from such s urface defects and internal flaws as would be deterimental to the end use of the material. These defects, however, will be ignored in the one metre length of coil from both ends
